subject: The flight deck of the colony ship ariadne at night, two officers on watch, stars in the big window. Michelle hasn't looked at the board once. She stands at the big window with the plate reader and a stylus, taking a reading off one patch of sky and writing it down, then taking another. Samuel is saying the night prayer, quietly, to the same stars. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
